C0161.title: Three Men Sentenced for Reselling Game Cheat Access Codes at a Markup
C0161.summary: In October 2025, the Fuxin Intermediate People’s Court reposted a case from Yanjin County People’s Court in Henan. From July 2022 to December 2024, Zhan, Shi, and He bought a game cheat called “FF Assistant” and resold it at a markup through online stores, earning between 45,000 yuan and over 114,300 yuan illegally. The court imposed prison terms from three years to two years and six months, with suspended sentences and fines.
